title: Attach focused Dart receipts for PowerShell arguments ending in a literal backslash
outcome: For a selector-free foreground launch with established PowerShell dialect, decode the source quoting correctly when a quoted option value ends in a backslash, and retain exact registered argv matching.
acceptance: A foreground PowerShell fixture with a double-quoted --plain-name value ending in a literal backslash attaches its own matching receipt. A different decoded or registered argv, and shell composition, remain refused.
